# Cultist Fanatic (`monsters:cultist-fanatic`)
*Medium or small humanoid, neutral* | **CR** 2 (XP 450; PB +2)
**AC** 13 ([Leather Armor](../equipment/leather-armor.md)) | **HP** 44 (8d8 + 8) | **Speed** 30 ft.
**STR** 11 (+0) | **DEX** 14 (+2) | **CON** 12 (+1) | **INT** 10 (+0) | **WIS** 14 (+2) | **CHA** 13 (+1)
**Saving Throws:** [Saving Throw: WIS](../proficiencies/saving-throw-wis.md) +4
**Skills:** [Skill: Deception](../proficiencies/skill-deception.md) +3, [Skill: Persuasion](../proficiencies/skill-persuasion.md) +3, [Skill: Religion](../proficiencies/skill-religion.md) +2
**Senses:** Passive Perception 12
**Languages:** Common
**Gear:** Holy Symbol, Leather Armor

## Actions
- **Pact Blade.** Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.
- **Spellcasting.** The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks):
  - At will: [Light](../spells/light.md), [Thaumaturgy](../spells/thaumaturgy.md)
  - 2/day: [Command](../spells/command.md) (level 1)
  - 1/day: [Hold Person](../spells/hold-person.md) (level 2)

## Bonus Actions
- **Spiritual Weapon (2/day).** The cultist casts the Spiritual Weapon spell, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
  - Other: [Spiritual Weapon](../spells/spiritual-weapon.md) (level 2)
